subject: Request: BYOK handshake logs + rotation evidence for SIG review
messages:
From: Lina Guerrero <lina.guerrero@acme-pay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: audits@brightaudits.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: BYOK handshake logs + rotation evidence for SIG review

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SIG submission we've got a couple of follow-ups from our security team and the external auditor: they need evidence that covers how Redwood handles customer-supplied keys (BYOK) and related KMS/HSM operations. Specifically: 

- A concise description of the BYOK onboarding handshake (what artifacts are exchanged, who signs what, and timestamped events).
- Signed HSM attestation for the HSM cluster used for key wrapping (most recent).
- KMS audit logs showing key creation/import, rotation events, and deletion events for the past 6 months for the BYOK flow.
- The documented rotation policy (SOP) and proof that rotation runs completed according to schedule (event timestamps).

Can you provide these as a single evidence bundle (PDFs or CSVs for logs) by COB Tuesday 2026-12-08? Our auditor (audits@brightaudits.com) is cc'ed and will ingest the files directly. If any of this requires an NDA or a Docusign exchange (BYOK addendum), let me know and we can expedite.

Appreciate it — this will unblock our SIG completion.

Thanks,
Lina
Director, Security Programs
Acme Payments
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: BYOK handshake logs + rotation evidence for SIG review

Team — forwarding Acme's request. They need a compact evidence bundle for SIG (BYOK handshake, HSM attestation, KMS audit events, rotation SOP + proof). Deadline: COB Tue 12/08.

Plan I propose:
- Neha: pull KMS audit export for BYOK-related keys (import/create/rotate/delete) covering 2026-06-01 to today. Include event IDs and timestamps; redaction of any customer PII is fine but keep key IDs.
- Marissa: retrieve the HSM attestation report (Nov 2026) and prepare a 1-page summary of the attestation scope; include signing authority and timestamp.
- Laura: draft a 1-page BYOK handshake summary and the rotation SOP excerpt showing scheduled cadence and owner; combine with a CSV of executed rotation events.

Attachments we'll produce (suggested): byok_handshake_summary.txt, kms_rotation_events_2026Q3-Q4.csv, hsm_attestation_nov2026.pdf.

Also note: Acme asked about a BYOK addendum signature. If we need a signature capture (DocuSign), we should prepare the addendum and route to them.

I'll coordinate the bundle and perform a quick QA before we send. Please confirm you can hit the deadline or flag blockers.

- Vivek
Head of Infra
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: BYOK handshake logs + rotation evidence for SIG review

Vivek — can confirm. I've exported the event stream for keys tagged with 'byok:' between 2026-06-01 and 2026-12-06. Items include: import, schedule-rotation, rotation-complete, rotate-fail (none in this window), and key-destroy events.

I attached a sanitized CSV (kms_rotation_events_2026Q3-Q4.csv) with columns: event_ts, event_type, key_alias, action_by_service, request_id. No customer payloads included. Also prepping a short README to explain our key aliasing (we use ephemeral envelope keys per-customer with a redacted prefix).

Marissa — do you have the attestation PDF from November? If you can drop that to the Drive link Vivek will create, I'll add a matching index of the attestation statements that map to SIG questions.

Laura — once you share the handshake paragraph I'll embed it into the README so the auditor has the narrative context for the CSV.

Neha
Security Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- kms_rotation_events_2026Q3-Q4.csv (sanitized export)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Guerrero <lina.guerrero@acme-pay.com>, audits@brightaudits.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 14:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: BYOK handshake logs + rotation evidence for SIG review

Lina / audits team — attaching the evidence bundle we put together for your SIG review. Contents: byok_handshake_summary.txt, kms_rotation_events_2026Q3-Q4.csv (sanitized), hsm_attestation_nov2026.pdf. We also included a signed BYOK addendum (signed-byok-addendum-docusign.pdf) — the DocuSign audit trail is available here: https://redwood.app/ds/RC-7F3K2.

Quick notes:
- The BYOK handshake summary explains the import flow and what is cryptographically asserted during import (key wrapping by HSM, origin assertion).
- KMS export contains event-level rows for import/create/rotate/destroy with timestamps and request IDs; we removed any customer PII.
- HSM attestation is the vendor-signed declaration for the HSM cluster that performs key wrapping for BYOK imports (Nov 2026).

If the auditor needs a different format (e.g., syslog export or raw JSONl) or additional sign-offs, please let us know. We'll keep the Drive folder open to your team for 30 days.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Infra
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- byok_handshake_summary.txt (summary + timeline)
- kms_rotation_events_2026Q3-Q4.csv (sanitized)
- hsm_attestation_nov2026.pdf (vendor attestation)
- signed-byok-addendum-docusign.pdf (signature artifact)
